constraints: Target must resolve to exactly one editable visible unlocked native Image with rasterState.colorRaster. ReferenceImage and src-only images are rejected.
Image stack params are structurally bounded to 8 KiB, depth 4, 64 object keys, array length 128, finite numbers and 512-character strings.

Source-dependent one-shot retouch only: Clone Stamp / Healing Brush / Patch. Source and target are explicit raster-local coordinates/regions inside the same target raster; no pointer emulation, source inference, cross-image sampling or raw mask. Pattern Stamp remains separate asset-contract work.

arguments.description: Explicit raster-local source contract only. Clone/Healing require sourceX/sourceY/targetX/targetY; Patch requires equal-sized sourceRegion/targetRegion. No pointer gestures, source inference, cross-image source, raw mask or pattern payload is accepted.
